name: tally
title: Tally
description: A count as tally marks, 1 to 99: bundles of four struck through by a fifth. The number is the accessible name, the box is exactly as big as the marks, and it is drawn on the server.

a11y: role="img" with aria-label set to the number (or your label): a screen reader hears "7", not seven strokes. Add the counted thing in visible text nearby.
The marks are the only place the number is shown as a drawing, so the svg is kept in Windows high contrast (as system colors).
Right-to-left pages start the first bundle on the right.
